name: @kmin/prospect-intelligence
description: Prospect Intelligence — the behavioural read engine shared by KMIN ventures. One browser file that turns interaction signals into a structured prospect profile, plus the server-side row shape. Names no venture.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.release: node build.mjs --check && node --test test/*.test.js && npm pack

//: ZERO DEPENDENCIES, like every repository that touches prospect data.
The build is a header stamp and a copy; the tests run on node:test.
Consumers vendor with tools/vendor.mjs into their own repository and check the
files in, so a consumer's deploy never reaches for a registry or for this
repository. pi.lock.json in the consumer pins the exact bytes.
